projectCheck.command: pnpm --dir browser typecheck && pnpm --dir browser build && pnpm --dir browser agent:check

findings: Three overused-font warnings in the shared SiteHeader for Geist and Geist Mono; retained because these are documented incumbent body/evidence faces and the page uses Bricolage for display specificity. No finding originated in learn.astro.

browserReview.note: The built static page was inspected at all three widths. Six chapters, 45 in-page links, two JSON-LD graphs, readable case-state labels, and the complete source index render without horizontal overflow or console errors. The mobile header follows the incumbent collapsed-nav behavior; all walkthrough destinations remain available through in-page actions.

ownerFeedback.note: Owner asked to steal the strongest useful patterns from the Qwen Chess learning surface and delegated the implementation.
